_note: Owner: Role Building. Every run and fight number in one place, plus the per-patch layer. Owner: Role Building. The per-patch balance job (Online & Accounts) may change ONLY the 'patch' block, under the rules in 'patch_job'; everything else is changed by Role Building. The fight code multiplies base stats by patch.class_mods, then patch.fighter_mods, then the active Pit Condition, so a balance change never needs code. Saved ghosts always fight on the current file. The keys the game reads today through src/data/load.js (Engineering) are kept exactly as they were. Everything else is Role Building's full structure; tests/role-building/data_check.mjs fails if the two ever disagree.

star.note: 3.24 x HP x 3.24 x damage = about 10.5x a 1-star: the design's '3-star is 10x'.

pen_min_top_tier_units.note: Each pen has at least one tier 3 or higher.

wild_stat_scale.note: Wild fighters start weaker than yours and catch up each round: scale = base + per_round x (round - 1).

runners.note: PROPOSED that tier 4 and 5 fighters run too.

pen_tier_odds._about: Chance per pen slot of each tier, rounds 1-13. Rows sum to 1. Rounds 1-6 follow the prototype formula; tier 4 and 5 columns are the design doc's proposed table; from round 7 tiers 1-3 shrink in proportion to make room (PROPOSED). Boss rounds (3, 6, 9, 12, 13) have no Raid; their rows are kept for completeness.
pen_tier_odds.status: tier 4/5 columns: awaiting confirmation (design open question)

copies_per_run._about: How many copies of each fighter exist in one run's pens. Ghost-spoil copies come from outside this pool.

patch._about: The only block the balance job writes. 1.0 = no change. Fields: hp, atk, as (attack speed), ability_power, heal_power, cc_seconds_add (seconds added to that class's own stuns and roots).

patch_job._about: Rules the Online & Accounts balance job follows each patch (design, layer 5). Numbers marked PROPOSED fill gaps the design leaves.
patch_job.measure: class share of 12-win runs: the fraction of 12-win final boards on which the class is at an active rank
patch_job.compare_to: average share across the 8 primary classes

step_rule.value: 3% at 5 points from average, rising linearly to 5% at 10 points or more

patch_job.direction: above average: multiply by (1 - step); below average: multiply by (1 + step)
patch_job.output: update patch.class_mods, bump patch.version, append one history row per change {class, field, from, to, share, average}, and write short patch notes

secondary_attributes.value: not adjusted by the job (too few tier 5 samples); Role Building tunes them by hand

pit_conditions._about: Weekly modifier (design, layer 6). Same fields as patch.class_mods, applied on top. Role Building writes the list; Engineering or the live job sets 'active'.
